title: Change Your Environment
devotional: Sometimes we ask God for strength while continuing to place ourselves in the same situations that repeatedly weaken us. Wisdom includes knowing when to change your environment. If a particular place, routine, device, conversation, or time of day repeatedly leads you toward temptation, you do not have to keep making the same situation harder than it needs to be. Creating distance is not running away from responsibility. It can be a practical expression of wisdom and self-control. Today, look at your surroundings and ask what you can change before the battle begins.
mind_check: What part of your environment repeatedly makes temptation easier for you?
body_move: Make one physical change today that creates distance from a known trigger.
spirit_move: Ask God to give you wisdom to recognize which boundaries you need and courage to actually put them in place.
way_out: Before temptation becomes strong, I will change __________ by __________.
prayer: Father, give me wisdom to recognize when my environment is making unhealthy choices easier. Help me make practical changes instead of relying only on willpower. Give me courage to create boundaries that protect my walk with You. Amen.
action: Choose one part of your environment that needs to change. Make that change today, even if it seems small.
